text:
avery (partnerships): LumenBridge asked for a focused perf/W interop sweep next Mon 09:30 PT. Goal: validate our memcpy/kernel tweaks + power-capping across their board family and produce a joint appendix (if numbers are parity). Partner will only accept anonymized aggregates. Prep doc: https://go/redwood/lumenbridge-watt :mag:

chloe (bench-ops): I'll reserve rack + PDUs 09:00-11:30 PT and attach the calibrated wall-meter. Planning a short validation + three sweep phases: ramped-power (90->150W), fixed-cap (120W), and thermal-hold (sustain at 140W for 10m). Need to confirm partner CSV header names and artifact sanitization method.

marco (eng-runtime): We'll run the same image for all runs. Two kernel variants: `stock` and `lb-memcpy-tuned`. We'll test both FP16 and int8 quantized paths. Please include `run_id` and `experiment_tag` in all outputs. Also want `eucalib` sanity trace (low-res) to align power traces — partner must agree.

isabel (kernel-team): Kernel team confirms `lb-memcpy-tuned` is ready. We will not export kallsyms or raw perf.data. Exportable artifacts: `metrics_<run_id>.csv` (aggregated), `hotspots_<run_id>.tsv` (anon ids + self_ms), `power_<run_id>.csv` (wall power). We'll run anonymizer: `redwood-scrub --strip-hosts --zero-ids` before upload.

lumenbridge-hw: We can provide wall-power traces at 200ms and board telemetry (freq,temp,ambient). Our preferred headers: `ts_ms,power_w,board_freq_mhz,board_temp_c,ambient_c,run_id`. We accept aggregated outputs only and require `run_id` to match. EUCALIB is fine if it's low-res and doesn't include host IDs.

chloe (bench-ops): Example command we'll run (two kernels x 3 phases):

```
./rundraft --model=redwood-small --seq=1024 --batch=8 \n  --kernel=lb-memcpy-tuned --profiles=ramped,fixed,thermal \n  --runs=3 --agg-hotspots=12 \n  --export-power=power_<run_id>.csv --export-agg=metrics_<run_id>.csv \n  --export-hotspots=hotspots_<run_id>.tsv --eucalib=lowres
```

ops-bot: Note: bench-bot will tag artifacts with `run_id=lumenbridge-2026-09-01-1`. S3 path: s3://redwood-partner-exchange/lumenbridge/ (partner read-only). Files will be scrubbed by `redwood-scrub` before upload.

marco (eng-runtime): Add `--limit-watts` flags during fixed runs to 120 and 140 to capture perf vs cap. Also include `--export-counters=counters_<run_id>.csv` with aggregated counters per 10s: `L1_HIT,L2_MISS,memcpy_bytes,ipc,gpu_idle_pct`.

isabel (kernel-team): Telemetry contract suggestion for `metrics_<run_id>.csv` headers: `run_id,timestamp_s,throughput_tok_s,avg_power_w,efficiency_tok_per_w,kv_cache_hit_rate,hotspot_count`. I'll open a tiny PR to bench-metadata with those headers (no symbols).

lumenbridge-hw: Confirmed CSV headers and read-only S3. Please ensure `metadata.txt` contains only redacted command lines, kernel_build_id, and `experiment_tag` (no hostnames, IPs, or image digests). We also request a 72h embargo for any public messaging until partner review.

chloe (bench-ops): Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/lumenbridge-sweep. I'll be oncall 08:45-11:45 PT. bench-bot will run a 3m smoke then full sweep; will post condensed summary (throughput_tok_s, avg_power_w, efficiency_tok_per_w) and attach anonymized hotspots.tsv after completion.

avery (partnerships): Action items:
- chloe: runbook + bench orchestration + upload + scrub step
- isabel: telemetry contract PR + hotspots TSV schema
- marco: update run commands with `--limit-watts` and counters export
- lumenbridge-hw: confirm CSV headers and embargo window

bench-bot: Prechecks passed. Run queued on rack-29 at 3069995400. Estimated full sweep ~50m. Will post results here when finished. :robot_face: 

lumenbridge-hw: We'll join the Zoom and provide power traces. Thank you for the scrub step.

chloe (bench-ops): Started small validation at 3069995520. Will report back with run_id and upload links when complete.
